findings.summary: isContentFingerprint accepts md5(32)/sha1(40) lengths and any even-length hex 32..64, while spec §1.3 phrases the requirement as "长度符合 sha256 语义". Not a gate bypass (empty/date/URL/"latest" are all still rejected), but tightening to 64-hex would match the spec wording exactly.

The unmapped_source branch is preserved verbatim and is NOT relaxed, but no test exercises it any more: all six SOURCE_ENUM members now map to a role, and the former in-enum-no-role case ('web-search') is now mapped. A regression test that temporarily removes a SOURCE_TO_ROLE key would keep UNMAPPED_SOURCE_RATIONALE pinned against future mutation (acceptance criterion 4, second half).

Web-class detection is exact-string and case-sensitive ("web"/"web-search"/"web-search-engine"). A case variant such as source="Web" with a non-empty non-fingerprint revision would escape 判据 A; 判据 B still catches the bare-URL + empty-revision shape. Case-normalising the source would close the residual variant.

Write-budget reservation counts every evidence item (needed = evItems.length + cluesAllowed + 1) including items that are later rejected and consume no write, so an all-rejected card is charged its full evidence count and can be reported budget/budget_infeasible while actually needing only the final CAS. Conservative (never over-spends) and only reachable above the 64-write default, but the reservation could exclude rejected items.
